evidence: complete the full loop via the upper suspension bridge.
From the car park, follow the signposted track through pristine West Coast rainforest to the viewing platform.
Continue along the track and boardwalks to reach the swing bridge across the Hokitika River.
At the junction just before the second viewing platform, follow the signs to Upper Hokitika Gorge.
After crossing the bridge, it’s a 30 min walk back to the car park through rainforest, with some ups and downs.

doubts: Two road-end features (F1, F2) are both unnamed tracks meeting Whitcombe Valley Road and the text does not say which is the car park (the loop may use both), so the start ref is null. Loop direction is not named; the text describes it via the lower swing bridge first, then the upper suspension bridge. W3's end: the page's option says the lower swing bridge, while its section continues 5 min past the bridge to the second viewing platform. W3 has no stated total time (its section gives only 6 min / 300 m from the viewing platform).
